dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not bad, Sorush! You really made the area regain its vitality real quick, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pari powers are quite fascinating, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: You startle pointlessly! My powers are more than enough to easily rescue the Sunyata Flower!

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: The dark corrosion expands yet, and these Sunyata Flowers are but one amongst its many victims...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: The other flower ponds have not been spared. Sefana must be in quite the fluster at this moment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This Sefana you mentioned seems like a nice Pari who works hard to take care of the flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's go help her, shall we, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Well now, I suppose it may serve as a suitable diversion upon my great work. In that case, my Yasnapati, I bid you have a care for Sunyata Flowers of this kind.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll tell you when I see them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! Let's save these pretty flowers together!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not bad, Sorush! You really made the area regain its vitality real quick, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pari powers are quite fascinating, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Of course, many Pari know how to bring Sunyata Flowers to life by heart.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Simply put, even though the Sign of Apaosha has disappeared, this Sunyata Flower hasn't recovered from its corrosion and it's still extremely feeble...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: The other flower ponds are unlikely to be spared. This must be very upsetting for Sefana.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This Sefana you mentioned must be a nice Pari who works hard to take care of the flowers!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's go help her, shall we, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: For me, it's nothing too difficult, and it'll help out Sefana. My Yasnapati, please keep an eye out for these Sunyata Flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll tell you when I see them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! Let's save these pretty flowers together!
